desc:
You're working the night shift at a local pharmacy. Patients keep arriving for their prescriptions, but some aren't human. Check their records, question them and decide who gets the capsules and who gets a bullet.

Can you survive all 7 nights and uncover whats happening at your local pharmacy? 😈

How to play:
📋 Compare prescriptions with the patient records
💬 Ask questions and watch for anything that doesn't match
💊 Sort capsules and give the right bottles to real patients
🔫 Use your revolver if you spot an anomaly..
📦 Restock shelves, answer calls, and keep the pharmacy running
👥 Work alone or team up with friends!

🌙 Multiple endings + Secret badge
♾️ Endless Mode: how many nights can you survive?
🔥 Normal & Hard difficulties
🏆 Earn badges and climb the leaderboard

❤️ Like & Join the group for +1 FREE REVIVE! ❤️

(Anomaly, Scary, Haunted, Jumpscare, Horror)
